title: dryopteris sparsa var. nitidula
intro: Dryopteris sparsa var. nitidula, commonly known as the fern, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Dryopteridaceae family. This plant is known to have various health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as cancer and heart disease. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris sparsa var. nitidula include acting as an antispasmodic, demulcent, and expectorant, which can help to relieve coughs, soothe digestive issues, and ease respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
